items.name: teams_summary
items.purpose: Summarize each team with its school context and distinct athletes across stored seasons.
items.problems: Historical affiliation-row overcount fixed without deleting history.
items.proposedImprovement: Preserve historical seasons; use explicit season filters for current roster metrics.
items.verification: 19 isolated PostgreSQL tests; all 3,516 team counts agree with live affiliation grouping; 127,357 affiliations retained.
items.rollback: Tested rollback_team_summary_count_20260905.sql restores count expression while retaining invoker security and all rows.
